text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон wins her first race and
fulfills her
ambition to take center stage
in a winning
concert.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now that she's experienced the joy of
standing
center stage...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her desire to become a top Umadol
grows even
stronger.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
